blocks.text: Monoclonal antibodies are laboratory-made molecules that strengthen the immune system's ability to fight pathogens. Because they target specific antigens, they are effective for treating cancer, autoimmune disorders and infectious diseases. (How they are made, by hybridoma cells, is described in Chapter 21.)
